lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately equidistant high-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-linear horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with primary circular blobs positioned at the intersection points between these vertical bands and longitudinal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the upward-facing surface and shadow on the downward-facing surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots localized on the visible surface and leading edge of the pectoral fin.
